_comment: I5 map top-node calibration (plan map-build I5; dossier docs/evidence/i5-map-proof.md §5.2). Top-3 files by summed function_cost_v2 in each of the 9 demo repos = 27 nodes. Each node was read at its cited span and classified by an independent read-only agent. Verdicts: GENUINE / REAL_BUT_MINOR / FP / TEST_NOISE (test, example, bench, fixture, tools, or generated path — valid code that must not drive a maintainer's first look). Reproduce: target/release/perfpal ../perfpal-test/<repo> -o out; sum function_cost_v2 per path; take top 3.

nodes.evidence: alacritty_terminal/src/term/mod.rs:3246-3247 (#[test] fn window_title inside #[cfg(test)] mod tests at :2507-2508) with the cost-driving literal loop `for _ in 0..4097` at :3270
nodes.reason: The 8203 cost is almost entirely a 4097-iteration test loop exercising title-stack capacity; cost-v2 known-trip weighting makes this test dominate the file's 10762 total.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — exclude #[cfg(test)] functions from the hot map / demote test-only loop counts

nodes.evidence: alacritty/src/input/mod.rs:170-445 — single match over Action at :171, no for/while/loop in the body
nodes.reason: Cost comes from branch/fanout breadth across ~100 match arms, not iteration; one dispatch per user action.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — nothing to optimize in a one-pass input dispatch

nodes.evidence: alacritty/src/event.rs:1841-2069 — single match over the winit event at :1842, no loops
nodes.reason: Breadth of the event match, not repeated work; each event is dispatched once.

nodes.evidence: tests/benchmarks/highlighting-speed-src/numpy_test_multiarray.py:2003-2013 (dtype loop nested with sort_kinds; 101-element arrays at :2011)
nodes.reason: Vendored NumPy test/benchmark fixture under tests/; test workload, not shipped code.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — exclude tests/benchmarks fixtures from the cost ranking

nodes.evidence: tests/integration_tests.rs:3473-3492 — test helper invokes bat() and asserts stdout/stderr; no loops in the span
nodes.reason: Test-only scaffolding; cost is subprocess/test overhead.

nodes.evidence: src/printer.rs:648,765-844 (per-line regions→ANSI-chunk→`for c in text.chars()`; per-chunk format!/escape at :777 and :897)
nodes.reason: Production output path invoked once per rendered line; per-character width/wrap and per-chunk formatting are real per-iteration work (buffer reuse, avoid repeated conversions).
nodes.maintainer_action: yes — profile large-file rendering, then reduce per-line/per-chunk allocations in print_line

nodes.evidence: tests/unity/test/tests/testunity.c:4571 literal loop bound `num_tested < 1000000`; body macro-gated to TEST_IGNORE in normal builds (:4559-4560)
nodes.reason: 1,000,000-iteration sweep inside the vendored Unity harness; test code must not drive a maintainer's first look.

nodes.evidence: tests/parse_hex4.c:37 literal loop bound `number <= 0xFFFF` (65,536 iterations), standalone test binary main at :66-68
nodes.reason: Exhaustive all-16-bit-values test loop, not cJSON library code.

nodes.evidence: cJSON.c:256-275 — item->next while-loop, recursive child delete at :261, per-node frees at :265/:270/:273; fn_cost 137
nodes.reason: Genuine production teardown, but each node is touched once with three conditional frees; inherent free() cost.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — one-shot teardown of caller-owned trees

nodes.evidence: src/click/core.py:3595 sole call site (Option.get_help_record); no loop in 3614-3696 beyond the envvar genexpr at :3632
nodes.reason: Help rendering executes once per option during --help, not in a per-iteration production loop.

nodes.evidence: src/click/_termui_impl.py:856 single subprocess.Popen(['xdg-open', url]); platform branches at :819/:832/:846 execute at most once
nodes.reason: One-shot external process launch plus blocking wait; OS spawn latency, not Python loop work.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — launch semantics are inherently one-shot

nodes.evidence: src/click/types.py:1177 os.stat; :1206/:1215/:1224 os.access; return at :1233; per value via src/click/core.py:2753-2759
nodes.reason: One-shot per path parameter value; the syscalls implement documented Path checks.

nodes.evidence: django/contrib/sessions/backends/cache.py:54 `for i in range(10000): save(must_create=True)`; returns on success at :59
nodes.reason: Literal 10000 bound is a retry-on-CreateError guard; the normal path returns after one save. The summed cost is a 10,000x model artifact.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — the loop exits on iteration 1 unless the cache is failing

nodes.evidence: tests/bulk_create/tests.py:234 list comprehension over range(100000, 101000) building 1000 objects
nodes.reason: Test fixture generating 1000 objects to exercise mixed-PK bulk_create.

nodes.evidence: tests/delete/tests.py:816 and :821 — two bulk_create generator expressions over range(0, 2000)
nodes.reason: Literal 2000-iteration test-data generation in a delete test.

nodes.evidence: src/command.rs:293-322 parameter-list Cartesian expansion, bounded by param_space_size; single startup call at src/main.rs:41
nodes.reason: Real loop but init-only; runs once during CLI startup, not per benchmark iteration.

nodes.evidence: src/metric.rs:273-280 single format! allocation; called from src/benchmark/mod.rs:291,340 per printed result line
nodes.reason: Output/diagnostic formatting once per benchmark row, not in the measurement loop.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — output formatting is not a performance path

nodes.evidence: tests/execution_order_tests.rs:31-34 four-line helper forwarding to cmd.arg(arg.as_ref())
nodes.reason: Integration-test harness; fn_cost 81 on a 4-line helper is a model artifact.

nodes.evidence: src/common/unicode/case_test.c:178 `for (char32_t code = 0; code <= 0x10ffff; code++)` (1,114,112 iterations); function inside #ifdef USE_ICU at :78-205; standalone test binary at src/common/unicode/Makefile:73
nodes.reason: Exhaustive Unicode codepoint loop in a USE_ICU conformance test, not shipped code.

nodes.evidence: src/common/unicode/category_test.c:63 `for (char32_t code = 0; code <= 0x10ffff; code++)`; #ifdef USE_ICU at :50; test binary at src/common/unicode/Makefile:75
nodes.reason: Full-Unicode-range comparison test against ICU; config-gated test work.

nodes.evidence: src/bin/psql/tab-complete.in.c:2171-5749 — 838 else-if branches and no for/while/switch; gen_tabcomplete.pl:93 defines SWITCH_CONVERSION_APPLIED and rewrites it at build time (Makefile:64, meson.build:27-28)
nodes.reason: No loop in the cited function; the cost is source-size/template artifact and the function only runs on interactive TAB presses.

nodes.evidence: tools/profile_divide.py:12-13 `for _ in range(10000): list(Segment.divide(...))`
nodes.reason: Entire 20013 cost is a 10000-iteration local benchmark loop in a tools/ script.

nodes.evidence: rich/console.py:2102-2117 batching loop only when len(text) > MAX_WRITE, inside the WINDOWS branch; Unix path single write at :2122-2124
nodes.reason: Per-flush size-guard on an I/O path, gated to >32KB payloads and Windows only; fn_cost 100.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — only revisit if a Windows profile shows write batching dominating

nodes.evidence: rich/text.py:1230-1249 per-line split/divide/justify/truncate loop; real work delegated to divide_line/line.divide
nodes.reason: Short per-line coordination loop; fn_cost 82, no specific per-iteration inefficiency.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — profile divide_line/Line.divide only if runtime wrapping is hot

nodes.evidence: format.c:6086-6328 single switch over parsed modifiers, one case per call; callers at format.c:6839,6909 (so the map's reachable=false is wrong); buffer growth at :6714-6717 is logarithmic
nodes.reason: fn_cost 1331 is statement/branch-count inflation of a dispatcher; no large loop.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — nothing actionable at this site

nodes.evidence: window-copy.c:5271 full-scrollback loop bound; :5288 per-line scan; :5272/:5314-5321/:5328-5332 200ms stop + 10s timeout, retry visible-only
nodes.reason: Large history scan is real but an explicit one-shot user search already time-boxed and degraded to visible lines.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — O(history) is inherent and guarded

nodes.evidence: window.c:882-940 three TAILQ_FOREACH scans of w->z_index; called from window_pane_at_position at :982 (mouse handlers)
nodes.reason: Trip counts are the pane count (a handful); fn_cost 94 reflects branch-heavy hit-testing, not a loop cost driver.
nodes.maintainer_action: no — tiny list scan on mouse events
